_about: Corrections to the gate map in gate-map.mjs: add or remove modules a gate covers, and files in tools/gate that are diagnostics, not gates.
_notGates: Diagnostics, the two-browser gates (gatesolo, gatelookhand, gatedisplayb, gatedisplayd, gatetruthlooks: run them by name on their own; gatesolo turns solo mode on). gatevoices is out again since Voices is shelved (B7134); run it by name if Voices ever stops the world from loading.
_timeouts: Minutes a gate may take when it needs more than run-gate's default (15), as {"gatename": 30}.
_clean: Chronicle Packs Desk e2: the clean smoke set, run in wodx-clean (run-gate.mjs --world clean --clean-set) after the nightly full run, on one lane. gatecleanworld is left out of the map because in rothenstein-wodx a chronicle is in play on purpose; the others are ordinary gates that must also pass with no chronicle in play.
_shelved: B7134: shelved modules (docs/MODULES.md, Shelved). Kept in the repo and never deleted, but no gate covers them: a change to one touches no gate, a gate that covers only shelved modules is left out, and the others drop them. tools/audit/coverage.mjs leaves their files out of an audit's scope, and so does the line-by-line review. Fix one only if it stops the world from loading.
